req.title: CCSU - First-year admissions requirements and deadlines

tuit.title: CCSU - Undergraduate tuition (effective fall 2026 to summer 2027)

test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT scores are optional for first-year and international applicants (Common Data Set: not required, but considered if submitted). Candidates offered admission have achieved a minimum 2.0 GPA and a class rank in the top 50 percent.

requirements.notes: Online application with a $50 fee or fee waiver, a personal essay, official secondary records (a NACES credential evaluation is recommended; SpanTran is the recommended service), passport copy and an Affidavit of Support. Letters of recommendation and SAT/ACT are optional. Admissions counselors usually send a decision within about two weeks of a complete application.

deadlines.label: International first-year apply-by date, fall 2027
deadlines.notes: Rolling admissions; international students 'should apply by' April 1 (fall) and November 1 (spring). The page prints no year, so fall 2027 is assumed. The university may stop processing applications once class capacity is met. Domestic first-years have a May 1 preferred date; the Common Data Set lists an application closing date of Aug 24, 2027.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Applicants whose native language is not English must submit one of the listed tests; the page lists no waivers. Applicants below the minimum may enroll in CCSU's Intensive English Language Program (IELP, 16-week full-time, 20 hours a week, seven levels) before gaining full admission.

english.notes: Internet-based minimum 79; the page also lists computer-based 213 and paper-based 550.
The page prints 'Internet minimum score of 4.5 (as of 1/1/26)' for the new TOEFL, so it is assumed to be the 1-6 band scale.

aid.notes: The college's own aid for nonresidents is non-need-based only (Common Data Set: 115 nonresident undergraduates received it, average $9,918). CCSU awards merit scholarships to select newly admitted first-year students with no separate application; no international-specific scholarship names or amounts are published on the pages reviewed. The Honors Program carries a $4,500-per-year scholarship.

cost.notes: Tuition rates and fees are from the Common Data Set for 2026-27; the CCSU tuition page lists the international full-time rate as $13,455 per term (tuition and fees together)

sat.note: No SAT institution code is printed on the pages reviewed.
